name: android_paginated_crawl_freecash_example
description: Example scaffolding for crawling a paginated Android offer list such as Freecash My Offers. This is a planning artifact until a generic workflow executor consumes paginated crawl plans directly.
notes: Use the android_paginated_crawl_run tool once the plugin surface is loaded in the running tool host.
Calibrate page-turn coordinates and recovery swipe once, then reuse the plan.
